subject: general
question: Which Indian cricketeer has featured in the most number of international cricket matches?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sachin Tendulkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Team India legend Sachin Tendulkar is the player with the highest number of matches in international cricket. In his illustrious career, the Master Blaster played 664 matches for India, breaking numerous records along the way. Hence, Option 4 is correct.**
 
• **Former Indian skipper ****MS Dhoni** enjoyed massive success in his captaincy leading India to major honours such as ODI World Cup, T20 World Cup and the Champions Trophy as well. Overall, **he played 538 games for Team India before calling time on his hugely international decorated career. **
 
• Another former Indian skipper, **Mohammad Azharuddin amassed 433 matches for India** in his widely decorated career which spanned between 1984 to 2000. After hanging up his boots, Azhar joined politics and is a prominent face of Congress in Telangana. 
 
• **Current BCCI president Roger Binny**** also features on this list having made a total of 424 appearances** for Team India in his illustrious career. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**__

 
 
• **It is the national governing body for cricket in India. **
 
• **The board was formed in December 1928 as a society,** registered under the Tamil Nadu Societies Registration Act.
 
• It is a consortium of state cricket associations and the state associations select their representatives who in turn elect the BCCI officials.
 
• **R E Grant Govan was elected as its first president and Anthony de Mello as secretary.**
